MediaPipe Face Landmarker model bundle, face_landmarker.task.
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
The MediaPipe project distributes this model for Face Landmarker under its
published project/model terms. Retain upstream model files and notices.

These runtime/model copies were already present in the author's Baiquan
project before this application was started. They are disclosed as
pre-existing third-party resources, not original Veil Studio code.

No original user images are bundled. The example portrait is an original
procedural illustration drawn by Veil Studio's renderer.
